svg.aria-label: The six metadata questions applied to the Lake Powell surface
svg.title: The six metadata questions, applied to the Lake Powell surface

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Reading the surface's metadata: the six questions from CCE 114

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every answer comes from the USGS release's metadata (doi:10.5066/P9XX0J1Y) and READ-ME-FIRST.txt. Check them yourself.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHAT

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What do the data represent?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A topobathymetric DEM: the lake bed and the

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: land around it in one surface. Elevation in

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: METERS above NAVD88 (geoid 12B). Your copy:

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 30 m cells, each the mean of 900 one-meter cells.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHERE

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Where, and in what coordinate system?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lake Powell, Arizona and Utah, the whole

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: reservoir. NAD83(2011) UTM zone 12N, meters.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Your copy: 4,340 x 4,331 cells, mostly NoData;

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the surveyed area hugs the canyons.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHEN

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: When were the data collected?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lake bed: multibeam sonar, Oct 8 - Nov 15, 2017.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dry shore: lidar, April 2-3, 2018. Gaps: maps

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: surveyed 1947-1959, before the dam closed.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Published by USGS June 3, 2020.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHY

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Why were they created?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: To support the USGS Utah Water Science Center's

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: new area-capacity tables for the reservoir, with

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the Bureau of Reclamation: the published areas

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: you check your answer against in Step 6.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How were they collected and processed?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Boat sonar, airborne lidar and digitized old

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: surveys, put on one datum and mosaicked at 1 m,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: blended along 5 m seamlines. Where neither boat

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nor lidar reached, gaps were interpolated.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHO

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Who made them, and may you use them?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: USGS EROS (Poppenga, Danielson and Tyler) with

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Reclamation. Public domain. The metadata says:

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: not for navigation, and conditions may have

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: changed since. Credit the USGS in your maps.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: For shorelines, WHEN matters most: the bed is as it was in fall 2017 and the shore as in spring 2018.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sediment settled since, and every ramp extended since, are not in it — and the datum must be converted before Step 3.
